name: Selection
description: Selection<ID>, the one ordered selection: the picked ids in picking order, the primary (the last picked), the anchor, one pick rule (replace, toggle, extend over an order) with canAdd, replace, clear, selectAll, prune and an arrow move in a grid. EK-2 declares it as a stub that keeps its ids; EK-10 fills the bodies and adds Nudge and Marquee here.
